items.impact: Normal reading runs can read primary sources but cannot safely mark a new or modified paper complete when the generated identity index must change, because this runtime cannot retrieve the entire large index as an editable payload.
attempted_fixes: Verified GitHub read and write operations separately.
Fetched the identity index through the available connector; the response was truncated before a complete editable payload was available.
Avoided publishing a partial paper artifact because publishing.md requires paper, identity index, plan and queue consistency.
items.next_action: Use an execution environment where the repository helper can run against a complete checkout and publish the generated index, or provide a connector operation that can apply the helper-generated full-file result without truncation.
